checklist_findings.question: Ser harnesset andre materielle problemer eller manglende regler vi ikke allerede har tenkt på?
checklist_findings.finding: Two pre-existing temporal_clustering findings (Skien around 2026-11-28/29; Ringerike 1 around 2027-03-13/14) are now carried by the teams that filled two of the retirement's vacancies instead of by Kongsberg/Tonsberg. It is already visible in `season findings` (actionable_unresolved_violation, strong_goal) and resolvable later via the repository's coupled-placement repair/search if the operator wants to pursue it; it does not need to block this publication. Separately, the full-season `season audit` reports FAIL, but with blocking_finding_count=0 and its sole reason an unrelated, pre-existing `tournament_placement_obligation` (9 unplaced U9-U12 tournaments, no JU12/Kongsberg involvement) that predates this change -- historical planning debt, not introduced here. No other anomalies or missing rules were found while reviewing the deterministic context, publication-evidence delta, or export artifacts for this change.
